context:
Goal: you can reply to Claude's reply on a page question, and your reply is never lost.
Problem (rule): the reply-back design needs your yes on four parts (which cards get a Reply button, where your reply line and its Undo sit, keeping an item open up to 7 days after Claude replies so you can answer it, and your reply showing on the closed item's line), and the effect of the 7 days is not measured.
Based on (ruling): Nov 6 12:58 CST, you asked for a way to reply back on a page question, since you had to edit your old answer to answer back.
Departs from: main closes an item as soon as Claude replies — the change keeps it open up to 7 days after Claude's reply, in case you answer it.
Meanwhile: the pull request that adds reply-back to the page (PR #2778) merges as reviewed; the 7 days only change on your answer.

lastAnswer.note: you're not correctly defining my reply is waiting correctly here it doesn't sound too right no?

options.gain: You can answer Claude's reply for a week before the item closes.
options.how: PR #2778 stays as built: Reply buttons and the reply line as drawn; after Claude replies, the item stays open up to 7 days in case you answer, then closes; your reply shows on the closed item's line.
options.label: Yes to all four parts (Recommended)
options.lose: An item you have nothing more to say on stays on the page up to 7 days after Claude's reply.

options.gain: Items close as soon as Claude replies.
options.how: A builder removes the 7-day wait from PR #2778, and the change is reviewed again. Reply buttons stay, and your reply still shows on the closed item's line.
options.label: Yes to the Reply buttons, the reply line and the closed line; drop the 7 days
options.lose: To answer Claude's reply you reopen a closed item; one more builder change and review.

ref: PR #2778 (adds reply-back to page questions); design notes docs/design/item-reply-back-notes.md; lane fan-prose-unmapped-2
reply: You are right; the wording was wrong (12:00 CST). What PR #2778 builds: after you answer and Claude replies on the card, the item stays open up to 7 days so you can answer Claude's reply, then closes. Nothing of yours is pending; the item waits for a reply you may or may not send. Pick a or b on that reading, or say what you meant instead.
short: Hold a close while your reply waits
title: Should a page question you answered stay open up to 7 days so you can reply to Claude's reply?
why: Recommended: a. It is what the reviewed change already does, and it keeps your replies visible.
